protocol.confidence_interval: 10,000 deterministic bootstrap resamples of 20 paired log-ratios
protocol.practical_win_rule: lower 95% interval > 1.10; smaller effects remain diagnostic
protocol.boundary: one fresh Node process per artifact and observation
protocol.memory: process-wide peak RSS includes Node/WASM initialization and operations; not matched library allocations

interpretation: Node-only published-artifact measurement. No browser, cross-host, canonical-string, or library-allocation claim.
